title: Business Income and Extra Expense — BizFlood Coverage Schedule by Tier
content:
Under BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), business income and extra expense coverage is written only on some tiers. Where it is written, the schedule below fixes the highest business income and extra expense limit per location, the hours that must elapse after the direct physical loss before business income loss is covered, the longest period of restoration, and the extra expense sublimit as a percentage of the business income limit.

## Schedule

| Tier | Business income written | Highest business income limit per location (USD) | Waiting period (elapsed hours) | Longest period of restoration (calendar months) | Extra expense sublimit (percent of business income limit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | No | 0 | 72 | 12 | 25 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | No | 0 | 72 | 12 | 25 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | Yes | 2500000 | 72 | 12 | 25 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | Yes | 2500000 | 72 | 12 | 25 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | Yes | 5000000 | 72 | 12 | 25 |
| BizFlood Large Property | Yes | 15000000 | 72 | 12 | 25 |

A highest business income limit of 0 means the coverage is unavailable on that tier.

## Points of reading

- **Which tiers write it.** BizFlood Building and BizFlood Building and Contents do not write business income and extra expense; the other four tiers do.
- **Waiting period.** On every tier the waiting period is 72 elapsed hours after the direct physical loss. It is counted in elapsed hours.
- **Period of restoration.** On every tier it runs at most 12 calendar months.
- **Extra expense.** On every tier the extra expense sublimit is 25 percent of the business income limit.

## Illustration (hypothetical limit)

A hypothetical location on BizFlood Multi-Location carries a business income limit of 2,000,000. That limit is within the tier's ceiling of 5000000 per location, and the extra expense sublimit within it is 25 percent of 2,000,000, that is 500,000.
